capabilities: Embed charts in notes with code blocks
Use note links and folder tree as datasets
Open linked notes by clicking chart marks
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13+ and the core Bases plugin; no network requests by default, with optional remote data and map tiles; API keys are stored in Obsidian's secret storage; detailed guide and gallery are hosted externally.
intentEvidence: Add an Agate chart view to any base.
problem: Obsidian notes and Bases contain structured properties, but there is no built-in way to turn them into custom charts, maps, or networks.
summary: Vega and Vega-Lite visualization plugin that renders charts from Bases views or agate code blocks.
